description: Download one attachment of a message and return its contents. Text files and PDFs with a text layer come back as text, PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP images (up to 5 MB) as an image you can see; any other file, and a scanned PDF, is saved under ~/.multi-mail/attachments and its path is returned with a note. Use it after read_email when the user needs what an attached invoice, report or photo says. Pick the file by part_id from read_email's attachment list, or by filename; a message with a single attachment needs neither. Returns an error listing the attachments if none matches. Does not change the mailbox.

account.description: Which mailbox: email address, alias, or local part. Optional when only one account is connected.

filename.description: Attachment file name, when part_id is not known.

max_chars.description: Longest text to return for text and PDF files (default 50,000); longer text is cut and marked.

message_id.description: Message id from search_emails or read_email.

part_id.description: partId from the attachments list of read_email.

name: get_attachment
title: Get an attachment
